youtube.description:
In 1967 every car in Sweden stopped before dawn and moved to the other side of the road, even though 83% of Swedes had voted no. So who decided which side you drive on?

From the right-handed swordsman theory and America's Conestoga wagons, to Paris keeping right in 1794, Napoleon's armies, Britain's 1835 law and its empire, this is how the world split in two, and the morning a whole country switched.
